items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And Robert Cheek's a good trumpet player. He was master in '61.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joseph Brown, very nice trumpet man. And Robert Cheek's a good trumpet player. He was master in '61. And one of the old timers, very fine musician was John K. Wyatt. Well, he's playing nothing but flute now. He's a man in his '80's now.
